'''yodaindahouze For 800 years have I trained Jedi...''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[yodaindahouze]]
* '''Published:''' 17 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mind What You Have Learned
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 MWYHL yodaindahouze LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

this is as original as it gets, but i wanted to know how it rated up. i haven't got to play it yet, but i think it'll do well.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

The deck works like a charm if you don't get messed up as far as locations go. you want to get training area down and get the next jedi test you don't have in your hand. get the other sites down and start training. this deck does lack another yoda and daughter of skywalker in case they're in the force pile or hand. the training is so you can send luke and the gang elsewhere to fight at your opponent's locations. training gets done pretty fast so you can utilize the rewards. any constructive criticism is welcome. thanks.
